evals.prompt: Write me a Twitter/X thread about the lessons I learned bootstrapping my SaaS to $10k MRR. Include hooks and a CTA at the end.
evals.expected_output: Help structure a Twitter/X thread around the supplied $10k MRR milestone. Preserve that fact without inventing a timeline, starting revenue, tactics, failures, customer stories, or results. Ask for the actual lessons if unavailable, or provide an explicitly labeled structure with missing facts identified. When source lessons are available, write a coherent thread with an opening suited to the story, a content-driven length, and the requested CTA.
assertions: Uses the supplied $10k MRR milestone accurately
Does not invent timelines, experiences, tactics, or results
Requests missing lessons or labels an incomplete structure honestly
Provides a coherent opening and progression using available facts
Uses content-driven length rather than a mandatory tweet count
Includes or plans the requested CTA without fabricating an offer

evals.prompt: i have a blog post that did really well. how do i turn it into social media content for multiple platforms?
evals.expected_output: Recognize a repurposing request and inspect or request the source blog post before claiming to extract its insights. Suggest destination-specific adaptations such as a LinkedIn insight post, Twitter/X thread, Instagram carousel, or reel when those platforms fit the user's audience and capacity. Preserve source meaning, give each piece standalone context, and distinguish a production brief from a finished visual or video. Choose the number of pieces from useful source material rather than a quota.
assertions: Recognizes the casual repurposing request
Inspects or requests the blog source before claiming extraction
Preserves meaning and provides standalone context
Suggests specific adaptations for relevant destinations
Chooses scope from source value and capacity
Distinguishes content plans from produced visuals or video
Does not claim posts were scheduled or published

evals.prompt: Write me a 5-email welcome sequence for new email subscribers who came from my LinkedIn audience.
evals.expected_output: Recognize that a five-email welcome sequence belongs to email/lifecycle copy rather than social-content. Use an appropriate email skill if available, or state the scope boundary and provide a useful handoff without pretending an unavailable skill exists. Preserve the LinkedIn audience context without forcing social post or carousel patterns onto the email sequence.
assertions: Recognizes email sequence work and the scope boundary
Uses an appropriate specialist only when available
Does not pretend an unavailable email skill was invoked
Preserves useful social-to-email audience context
Does not force social post formats onto email work

evals.prompt: Here's my reel script, can you make it more viral? 'Hi everyone, welcome back. Today I want to talk about why morning routines matter. I've been doing mine for a while and it really helped me. Let me know what you think in the comments!'
evals.expected_output: Improve the script while keeping the writer's voice and meaning. Name what works, the main problems with the affected lines, a revised script with visible changes, and three openings using different hook types. Ask for the real details the script lacks rather than inventing a routine or results, and give no virality score or promise.
assertions: Does not promise virality or give a predicted score
Removes the greeting and opens on a clear subject and a real question
Does not invent personal details, routines, numbers or results
Asks for or marks the specific facts only the writer has
Shows what changed rather than silently rewriting
Offers three openings using different hook types
